# EXBO Launcher Fork

Private visual fork of the EXBO / STALZONE launcher.
Stack: Kotlin 2.0, OpenJFX 21, JDK 21, Gradle wrapper 8.10.2.
Docs site: Astro Starlight. Russian is the root locale. English mirrors the same paths under /en/.
Repository notes stay in docs/. This site is the website/ directory.

AppContext is the only place implementations are chosen.
mock: showcase, screenshot tour, tests, and any launch where launcher.demo is set or ExboApi.installed() is false.
live: a normal Windows launch when bootstrap.jar, launcher/launcher.jar, and java/bin/java.exe exist under the EXBO roaming root.
The UI sees domain interfaces only. The README list of removed network pieces describes the mock layer. It does not cancel live.

Windows Setup (#36, on main) is a per-user NSIS wizard: no UAC, default %LOCALAPPDATA%\LauncherFork, and the path always ends with \LauncherFork, including silent /S /D=....
Click order follows the public EXBO article: choose the folder, Change Folder, Next, wait. The desktop shortcut is optional and on for a silent install. The Start Menu shortcut is always created. Finish can launch the launcher. The game is downloaded later from inside the launcher.
Display name EXBO Launcher, publisher EXBO, game STALZONE. Setup does not write or delete HKCU\SOFTWARE\EXBO (EXBO_SESSION), the game directory, or %APPDATA%\EXBO.
A same-named shortcut is replaced or deleted only when it points at this LauncherFork.exe. SHA-256 of every shipped file is checked before replace and after copy. A mismatch, a missing file, or missing PowerShell aborts with exit 3 and does not write the marker .launcherfork-install. File size is not enough. A foreign runtime or app without that marker exits 2.
Authenticode is TODO: there is no certificate in the repo. Apps & features still shows publisher EXBO and product EXBO Launcher with no signature, so this unofficial fork can be confused with the official ExboLauncher.
Not copied from the original, because it is not in the public help: the original wizard artwork, a license page, and the official default directory. The sidebar image is built from the fork icon.
Build the wizard on Windows with packaging/build-installer.ps1. On Linux, packaging/build-dist.sh only compiles the exe. The wizard is not clickable there. Payload SHA-256 on install is PowerShell on Windows.

Live registration does not create an account. ExboAuthService.register returns RegisterError.NOT_SUPPORTED. The form shows fork.reg.error.unavailable: «Этот лаунчер не создаёт аккаунт. Создайте его на сайте STALZONE.» There is no registration API in this repo. Mock registration is unchanged: any name except a taken one still succeeds, and the age gate still applies.
Launcher self-update is fail-closed. decideLauncherUpdate and stageLauncherUpdate in LauncherUpdateGate.kt reject any offer as unsigned until a release public key is pinned. The file is never written. The window shows auth.update.rejected: «Обновление лаунчера отклонено: нет проверенной подписи.» When there is no offer, the check finishes and login can open. Installer Authenticode is a separate TODO and is not this check.

Windows on main: pre-main is 460 wide. Height follows the panel, from 280 to Theme.AUTH_WINDOW_HEIGHT 700. Login 460×506, mail 2FA 460×438 idle / 460×526 with error, TOTP 460×444 / 460×532, launcher update 460×316 fitted before the first show. Registration and age keep prefHeight 668 and the full 460×700 window. Main window 1024×640, minimum 900×580. The side column is 253 px at 1024 and tracks the window between 220 and 340 px. The logo scales with the column. The game subtitle stays inside the row. The settings column fills the content area; the 820 px cap is gone. At 1280 px the tunnel page uses the full content width.
Steam and Epic on the login panel are hidden.

Tunnel writes a per-region Roxy override to jvm_wrapper/overrides.json and the game flag -Droxy_address_override.<region>=host:port. Measure does not write the file. Find best writes one node. Group exclude asks first («Заблокировать N нод группы?» / «Вернуть N нод группы?»). Cancel leaves exclusions, the blocklist, and the firewall alone. A node switch changes one id immediately. Rows with no valid IPv4 stay hidden. CLOUD-* pools are filtered out before the list, measure, and find-best.
Mock reads the tunnel catalog from the classpath when mockCatalog is set (!liveBackend): servers-ru.json, servers.json, the NEA fixture. It does not fetch that list. Live catalog hosts are unchanged and are HTTPS. Loading («Загружаю группы…»), error («Не удалось загрузить группы» with «Повторить»), and an empty catalog are separate cards. The loading card shows only while the region list is still on the way. The heading, the action panel, and the group cards are separate blocks. «До вас» / «Пинг» and the block toggles stay in place. Labels fit in full at 900×580 and 1280×760.
P2P mode and download/upload KB/s limits are saved in settings.properties. SessionManager does not receive them. They do not affect the torrent.
There is no graphics settings page and no sound settings page. Sensitivity is a settings-header page and writes options.json when that file already exists.
Docs sidebar: Старт, Игра, Сеть, Настройки, Архитектура, Дизайн, Справка. Screenshot PNGs under docs/screenshots are referenced for local preview and are not copied into the Pages build.

Default theme zone. Accent #e91932, hover #ff3b52, background #0a0a0a, card #181818, muted #bdb2a6.
Launcher zone fonts are Bebas Neue and Roboto. This site uses Manrope (body), Bebas Neue (hero and H1), IBM Plex Mono (code).

Run the app: ./gradlew run
Run the docs: cd website && npm install && npm run dev
Check the docs: cd website && npm run verify
Pages workflow: .github/workflows/docs-pages.yml (source: GitHub Actions). A private repository may not publish the site publicly.
Site: https://nyrokume.github.io/exbo-launcher-fork/
